native_editor.workflow: Production dialog creates/registers page, opens generated scene; canonical duplicate rejected without catalog mutation

test_changes: Scroll-origin test now expects the previous entry scroll position on Back, as required by the new history contract.
Responsive test asserts natural minimum height instead of removed canvas API.
Kubuchan invalid redundant cast repaired; authored narrative assertion remains failing. Reply width uses rendered rectangles rather than obsolete custom minima.
limits: Sixteen scenes failed on the dependency base. The same scene set fails after this change; unchanged scene identity does not imply identical errors.
Kubuchan was blocked by a parser error in the baseline. It now executes and reports the existing content assertion about the public admin-bot assumption. Post text was not changed.

A fresh baseline Editor scan separately reproduced compatibility_assessment_test.gd:26 Array(null). The runtime scene passes. Website workflow PASS does not establish an error-free complete Editor scan.
Some logs contain existing ObjectDB/resource-leak warnings on shutdown; these remain visible in the evidence.
Local production-site screenshots use startup game state. They do not cover every narrative branch. CI uses its existing asset-placeholder preparation and Godot 4.6.3 on Linux.
GameEffectData remains nontransactional: earlier effects may apply before a later effect fails; no success feedback or navigation follows failure.
